description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). Big(n LONG, t TEXT(60)) with 2048 rows n = 1..2048 inserted in order, t a 50-character text, no index. A dynaset over Big: AbsolutePosition put to each window start (390-510, 890-1010, 1290-1410, 1790-1910), then for every position of the window the Bookmark and n, MoveNext between. Then a table-type recordset over Big walked the same way (its Bookmark is the row's slot and data page). Asks at which positions the dynaset number leaves base + position, by how much, and whether the steps fall where the rows cross a data page.

args.text: CREATE TABLE Big (n LONG, t TEXT(60))
